requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that composite_credibility_score is correctly calculated from input attributes (prior_trials_count, publications_count, fda_approval_count, and affiliation weight).
The system must verify via unit tests that each individual PI attribute field is correctly mapped into the scoring logic without omission.
The system must validate that the PI credibility schema returned by the API conforms to the defined Pydantic model structure.
The system must execute integration tests confirming that evaluate_care_facade responses include PI credibility data for each clinical trial result.
The system must validate that PI credibility enrichment does not remove or alter existing clinical trial fields in the API response.
The system must confirm via integration tests that multiple trials in a single response each receive distinct PI credibility evaluations.
The system must validate that PI credibility scoring remains deterministic given identical input data across repeated test runs.
The system must handle missing investigator_name by returning a null or default PI credibility object without throwing an exception.
The system must assign a minimum or zero composite_credibility_score when a PI has no prior trials or publications.
The system must correctly aggregate PI history when investigator names vary slightly across sources (e.g., formatting or initials) without duplicating records.
The system must fail the test suite if PI credibility fields are missing from any clinical trial response after API integration.
The system must validate that extreme input values (e.g., very high publication counts) do not produce invalid or unbounded composite scores.
